...
I have no right to stop them.
It doesn't matter if he was Caster's puppet, Kuzuki didn't put a stop to what Caster was doing.
Not only did he not stop Caster from draining the townspeople's magical energy, he even encouraged her to do it.
In that case... Even if Kuzuki is not a mage, he is still without a doubt a Master in this war.

page1.text:
To a Master, defeating your opponent means killing them.
He was aware of this fact before getting himself involved thus far, and he chose to fight knowing he will have to kill or be killed trying.

page2.text:
Kuzuki is not seeking any help, nor is he admitting his defeat.
The only thing that will stop the man in front of me is death.
...But.
As a Master myself, how can I stop them?
